channels.name: cmd_chan
channels.purpose: Accept one GEMM job: opcode plus A/B/Y base pointers.

signals.name: cmd_opcode
signals.semantic: Legal only 8'h01. Selects the single supported GEMM job.

signals.name: busy
signals.semantic: High while a GEMM job is in progress.

signals.name: error
signals.semantic: One-cycle pulse on any non-OKAY AXI4-Lite response on the shared manager port.

interface_contract.global_handshake_rules: Every VALID/READY pair follows standard AMBA stability: once asserted, VALID and its payload/address/data hold stable until the paired READY active edge. All producer VALIDs are held low throughout active reset.
